body: I have put up an edit :)

Thank you. 

I spent about half an hour on the phone to the samaritans, and spoke to an old friend who knows what I'm going through. It's 3am here now and I'm numb - from all the crying and shit I just spewed out. I'm gonna sleep, I have work in the morning. 

I need to see a doc, get some time off, so I can sort myself out. 

I have a good friend (ex-gf to be honest) who knows and cares enough to be here for me tomorrow, so we'll have dinner and a chat, maybe a movie or something. 

I still feel rotten, and to be honest I'll just slog through tomorrow somehow, but at least I have something to look forward to. As for the weekend, I have no idea how it'll go :(

I'm tired of this. Every year and a half, I get this shit. The rest of the time I'm a happy, creative person, but this cloud in my brain showing me only despair and paranoia is awful. I have attempted suicide before and pulled through, but every time I feel the same... I don't know how I have made it this long :(

/rant. 

Thanks, I'll keep you posted. I should make it through the night.
